affected.note: Email addresses used for free membership registration of the Itsudemo Rilakkuma site between 2014-03-18 and 2020-01-19. The company said no other data such as passwords was confirmed leaked.

summary.en: Imagineer, operator of the official Rilakkuma fan site Itsudemo Rilakkuma, detected abnormal access to its management server on 2020-12-30. It reported that 105,180 member email addresses were leaked through unauthorized access exploiting a system vulnerability.
summary.ja: イマジニアは、リラックマ公式サイト「いつでもリラックマ」の管理サーバーへの異常なアクセスを2020年12月30日に検知した。システムの脆弱性を突いた不正アクセスにより、会員のメールアドレス105,180件が流出したと公表した。
